name: Ji-Hwan Park
greeting: Thank you for visiting my website!
bio:
I am a master's student at the Terramechanics and Cyber-Physical Systems (TCPS) Laboratory, Department of Convergence Biosystems Engineering, Chonnam National University.

My research focuses on modeling and simulating the interaction between off-road machinery and terrain — combining the discrete element method (DEM) with data-driven approaches to describe soil behavior more faithfully.
